issues.issue: Whether the trial judge’s error was harmless or outside the curative proviso.
issues.applicant_position: The error was not harmless; it affected the fairness of the trial.
issues.respondent_position: The error was harmless; the DNA evidence was the sole basis for conviction, and the judge relied entirely on it.
issues.result_text: The court found the error was harmless and caused no miscarriage of justice.

issues.issue: Whether the inadmissible propensity evidence prejudiced the trial judge’s acceptance of DNA evidence.
issues.applicant_position: The bad character evidence was inadmissible and made the trial unfair.
issues.respondent_position: The judge was unaware of the bad character evidence and relied solely on DNA.
issues.result_text: The court did not find that the bad character evidence prejudiced the judge's decision.

issues.issue: Whether the Crown’s use of DNA evidence alone was sufficient for conviction despite the inadmissible propensity evidence.
issues.applicant_position: The DNA evidence was sufficient; the trial was fair.
issues.respondent_position: The DNA evidence alone does not establish guilt; the trial was unfair due to inadmissible evidence.
issues.result_text: The court did not decide on sufficiency of DNA evidence alone.

issues.issue: Whether the trial judge’s reasons show reliance solely on DNA evidence and no improper influence from propensity evidence.
issues.applicant_position: The reasons show reliance only on DNA, so no unfairness.
issues.respondent_position: The reasons do not address the propensity evidence, so reliance may be implied.
issues.result_text: The court did not explicitly decide on the reliance issue.

issues.issue: Whether the application of the curative proviso was appropriate in this case.
issues.applicant_position: The case was overwhelming; the proviso should apply.
issues.respondent_position: The case was not overwhelming; the proviso does not apply.
issues.result_text: The court did not apply the proviso, citing lack of overwhelming evidence.

issues.issue: Whether the appeal should be dismissed or allowed.
issues.applicant_position: The appeal should be allowed due to unfair trial.
issues.respondent_position: The appeal should be dismissed; no miscarriage of justice.
issues.result_text: The court dismissed the appeal, affirming the conviction.
